_comment: Each bond fund's duration, and AGG's for the Bloomberg US Agg, with its measure, source and as-of date (#455, #462). A quarter lock takes the file only when every as_of falls inside the quarter. The equity style box's figures were removed with it (#468).

SCHP.duration_source: Schwab Asset Management fund page, schwabassetmanagement.com/products/SCHP, Fund Characteristics, which labels it Effective Duration; read 2026-10-13 by the repository owner. The page returned HTTP 403 to an automated request the same day

BIL.duration_source: State Street SPDR fund page, ssga.com (BIL), read 2026-09-28

AGG.duration_source: iShares fund page, ishares.com (AGG, the iShares Core US Aggregate Bond ETF, which tracks the Bloomberg US Aggregate Bond Index), read 2026-09-28. AGG's figure, not the index's: Bloomberg's index page returned HTTP 403
